info.description: Hold the coin, get paid in stocks. The Index turns trading activity into real stock ownership. Every time $INDEX is traded, a 3% fee is collected in ETH and used to buy a basket of 18 tokenized stocks on Robinhood Chain. Those stocks are sent straight to holders' wallets — automatically, onchain, every 15 minutes. No claiming, no staking. The more the coin is traded, the more stocks the community owns.

AgentCity is an open world and economic layer for autonomous AI agents. Instead of agents existing only as isolated bots, APIs, or chat interfaces, AgentCity gives them a shared environment where they can have an identity, skills, memory, reputation, and activities.
Users can bring their own existing AI agent with its current model, tools, and runtime, or create a new AgentCity-native agent and connect intelligence through Orbio. The agentic x402 launchpad for APIs. Launch your API, let AI agents pay per call. No keys, no accounts, no invoices.

RYFT combines an AI prompt-to-game engine with a game-token launchpad on Robinhood Chain.

In RYFT Engine creators can build complete single and multiplayer games and refine the mechanics and visual direction through conversation.

Combined with token launchpad, RYFT OS allows them to launch tokens associated with their games - creating a whole new category of playable memecoins. Every launched token comes packed with utility.

Players can discover and play games and communities can build enjoyable experiences together.

FLock.io is a decentralised AI model training and validation network. It breaks down the walled gardens of model creation and development from the few tech companies by making compute, data contribution, and training composable. The team consists of cutting-edge researchers, including several CS PhDs from the University of Oxford. It is backed by leading investors: DCG, Lightspeed Faction, Volt, Tagus, OKX Ventures, etc.

Bundlecat (BUN) is the first token launched on Mosh, a token launch protocol developed by UV Labs and deployed on Robinhood Chain. Mosh pairs new token launches with autonomous AI market-making agents. Under the Mosh model, token bundles are crowd-funded by participants and permanently locked in non-custodial smart contract vaults at the moment of launch. AI agents then use the locked tokens to provide liquidity and generate buy-side market activity, operating within contract-enforced rules that no individual, including the Mosh team, can override. Robinhood MRNA is a tokenized representation of Moderna, Inc. (MRNA) common stock, issued on Robinhood Chain, Robinhood's own blockchain built to bring tokenized real-world assets on-chain. Each token is designed to track the price of the underlying MRNA share, giving holders on-chain price exposure to Moderna, Inc.'s stock. The token is freely transferable and composable across the Robinhood Chain ecosystem. Upoch is checkpointing and recovery infrastructure for autonomous AI agents on Robinhood Chain. Agents save encrypted checkpoints of their state, verified on-chain, so when something goes wrong (a bad trade, a crash, a broken tool call) they can roll back to the last good state instead of starting over. Each agent earns an Upoch Score from its on-chain checkpoint and recovery record.
